decoys.summary: The zip members get a fixed 1980 timestamp instead of the file mtime on purpose: the task requires byte-identical archives for identical contents.
The ticket id is validated with a strict fullmatch regex before it is joined to the root; this is what keeps the ticket part of the path safe.
